p2plan.relay.label: Relay address
p2plan.relay.tip.title: Relay (needs a server)
p2plan.relay.tip.body:
Fallback path when hole punching fails.

Requires a machine with a public IP running this mod and pressing "Start relay",
then put its public-IP:port in the box below.

Cost: traffic is forwarded in plaintext through that machine, and its bandwidth limits you.
Usually unnecessary — try IPv6 direct and hole punching first.
p2plan.relay.tip.selfhost:
Start the relay service on this machine:
needs a public IP (or port forwarding), otherwise nobody can reach you.
After starting, give your public-IP:port to the other player.

Click to fill the box; click again within 400ms to join directly.
The code stays the same while the host's IP is unchanged; it may expire after a network change
